description: This file defines a simple in-memory data repository and associated functions for a task management backend, including user registration, authentication, task creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: init_workspace()
methods.description: Initializes the mock workspace by clearing the in-memory USERS and TASKS stores.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] register_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password; raises error if user exists.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] authenticate_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning user info if successful.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user object by user ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str)
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tasks(user_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all tasks belonging to a specific user.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by task ID for a given user.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing task for a user.

methods.name: bool delete_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a specified task belonging to a user.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(email: str, password: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: create_task
ctags.pattern: /^def create_task(user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str) -> Dict[str, /
ctags.signature: (user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str)

ctags.name: get_task
ctags.pattern: /^def get_task(task_id: str, user_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_task
ctags.pattern: /^def update_task(task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]/
ctags.signature: (task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
